value.rationale: The icosahedral graph has canonical six antipodal axes and nonabelian A5 symmetry. A six-dimensional ordinary Betti number cannot distinguish the new irreducible rational A5-module from six trivial lines. The integral signed-permutation lattice, geometric collapse and complete full-group action provide a motivated exact classification, not a routine numeric gain. The original nonequivariant wedge is acknowledged, and no equivariant homotopy splitting is claimed.
